show: My Favorite Murder with Karen Kilgariff and Georgia Hardstark

einzeiler: Listeners share wild family genealogy surprises, childhood schemes, and celebrity…
kurzfassung: This minisode features listener-submitted hometown stories covering unexpected genealogical ties, bizarre childhood businesses, and a funeral suit mix-up. Other tales include a chaotic Tinder group chat and a late-night sidewalk hangout with Alan Cumming. The hosts wrap up with updates on their pets and community shout-outs.
stichpunkte: A listener discovers her family tree connects directly to Bathsheba Spooner, the first woman executed in America.
A childhood entrepreneur makes six dollars selling captured grasshoppers to neighborhood kids before releasing them out of guilt.
A grieving family accidentally buries their grandfather in an uncle's missing brand-new suit.
A mother finds herself added to a WhatsApp group chat containing all of her Tinder date's other matches.
A listener recalls her grandmother's youthful adventures partying in a remote cabin with a young Gordon Lightfoot.
A young stand-up comedian overcomes imposter syndrome after spending an entire evening hanging out on a curb with Alan Cumming.

kapitel.titel: Irish Grand Lore and Gordon Lightfoot

clips.hook: Discovering a notorious historical murderer in the family tree
clips.text: A listener discovers through family history research that her own grandfather was related to serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer.

clips.hook: Tier-pricing grasshoppers on a sidewalk stand
clips.text: Cindy experiences total shock when police arrest her fiancé Kenny for child abuse, a claim she immediately refuses to believe.

clips.hook: Grandpa was accidentally buried in someone else's brand-new suit
clips.text: The hosts debate the moral dilemma of keeping mistakenly acquired cash versus tracking down the owner to return it.

clips.hook: When a dater accidentally groups all his Tinder matches into one chat
clips.text: The podcasters read a listener email responding to a previous episode's request for family anecdotes about swapping grandparents.

clips.hook: Alan Cumming's witty reaction to a young comedian
clips.text: The hosts joke about setting up a brutal betting pool to see which of their elderly pets will pass away first.
